title: The Storm-Tossed Sea Maiden

hints.text: Look for the garden space associated with Master Gracey.
Inspect the fountain face rather than only the water or surrounding plants.
Find the sea-maiden face in Master Gracey's garden fountain, with wild hair and a startled expression.

revealDescription: Master Gracey's garden includes a fountain with the face of a sea maiden whose windswept hair and startled expression make her look caught in a storm.
